Update 10/11: After going completely out of stock yesterday, Apple’s 2026 next-generation Apple Polishing Cloth is now available for purchase again at $9 Prime shipped via Amazon.

Amazon’s early Black Friday sale is now live, and it includes a number of official Apple accessory deals starting this morning. Alongside some big-ticket deals on AirPods Pro 3 at $50 off, the $250 price drop on M5 MacBook Air, and Apple Watch Ultra 4 at nearly $100 off, there are some serious Apple add-on offers going live today.

We have the return of all-time low pricing on AirTag 2 at $17.50 each, some rare discounts on the latest Magic Mouse in black and the classic white/silver livery, the ongoing low on its 2026 Magic Keyboard, and the lowest price around for the iPhone Duo-ready Apple Pencil USB-C. All of that joins as much as 40% off Apple’s iPhone 18 Pro case lineup (several models have hit new all-time lows as of this morning), and even more waiting down below.

Early Black Friday Apple gear deals

AirTag 2

Apple’s 2026 AirTag 2 is arguably one of the best low-cost Apple gifts you can buy someone (or yourself), and both the single listing and the 4-pack are now sitting at Amazon low prices. We are looking at just $17.50 a pop on the 4-pack:

  • 1-pack AirTag 2 $23 (Reg. $29) – Matching all-time low
  • 4-pack AirTag 2 $70 (Reg. $99) – Matching all-time low

Magic Mouse

The latest USB-C Magic Mouse is getting an official Amazon early Black Friday deal starting today, brining both models back down to some of the lowest prices we have tracked and deals on Magic accessories can be quite rare:

  • Magic Mouse White $60 (Reg. $79)
  • Magic Mouse Black $80 (Reg. $99)

New 2026 Magic Keyboard

The deal Magic rolls on with the ongoing all-time low on its brand new (mostly) all-glyph Magic Keyboard. Amazon is offering the base and most affordable model down at the lowest price it has been offered right now:

  • Apple Magic Keyboard (NEW 2026 model) $80 (Reg. $99)

Magic Trackpad

And speaking of rare Apple Magic accessory deals, the Magic Trackpad is infamously resilient when it comes to discounts. While the prices have (very slowly) been dropping over the last year, both the classic white and black models are now sitting at Amazon lows:

  • Apple Magic Trackpad White $116 (Reg. $129)
  • Apple Magic Trackpad Black $130 (Reg. $149)

Apple Pencil USB-C

The new iPhone Duo foldable has breathed new life into its existing USB-C-equipped Apple Pencil, making it easily one of the hottest Apple accessories on the market right now. But don’t pay full price on the Apple Store – you can score it brand new on Amazon for less:

  • Apple Pencil USB-C $69 (Reg. $79)

Apple 40W Dynamic Power Adapter with 60W Max

The charger Apple recommends to fast charge your iPhone Duo is also lower at Amazon than it is anywhere else right now. It’s not massive deal, but don’t pay full price for the same thing:

  • Apple 40W Dynamic Power Adapter with 60W Max $35 (Reg. $39)

Latest Beats 240W Braided USB-C Cables

  • Beats 240W Braided USB-C Cable Navy $13 (Reg. $30)
  • Beats 240W Braided USB-C Cable Red $14 (Reg. $30)
  • Beats 240W Braided USB-C Cable Stone $16 (Reg. $30)
  • Beats 240W Braided USB-C Cable Black $18 (Reg. $30)

Apple iPhone 18 Pro/Max cases

Much like the Magic Mouse above, and as you can see on the listings themselves, Amazon is serving up some official early Black Friday deals on loads of Apple’s iPhone 18 Pro and Pro Max cases. You’re looking at up to 40% off the list prices here and deals from $29, with new all-time lows landing across various mode like the new Burgundy and Black TechWoven variants:
